jobs.description: Job Description About Bluehive Most organizations do not struggle with tools. They struggle with how work actually flows.Too many processes, unclear ownership, and teams working next to each other instead of together.That is where Bluehive comes in.We help organizations bring structure into the way they work. Using platforms like Asana, but more importantly by designing workflows, aligning teams and making sure changes actually stick in practice.Bluehive is part of One Productivity Group, a pan-European group focused on improving how organizations operate. Across our brands, consulting, technology and execution come together to create better workflows, stronger collaboration and more scalable operations. About the role This role is for someone who enjoys understanding customer challenges, identifying opportunities and turning them into meaningful business relationships.As an Account Executive, you help organizations recognize where their current ways of working create friction and where better workflows, clearer structures and stronger collaboration can make a real difference. You guide prospects through that journey, from first conversation to closing, by combining commercial drive with a strong understanding of customer needs.The role sits at the intersection of business development, consultative sales and organizational improvement. You work closely with SDRs, consultants and solution colleagues to shape opportunities, build trust with stakeholders and help customers move confidently toward the right decision.It is a commercial role, but one built on substance, credibility and long-term value.Your mission What the role involves • Leading sales conversations with prospective customers and understanding how their current processes, tools and ways of working are set up • Identifying challenges around collaboration, ownership, structure and operational efficiency • Showing how Bluehive’s solutions can help organizations work in a more structured, aligned and scalable way • Managing opportunities independently throughout the full sales cycle, from qualification to negotiation and closing • Building relationships with internal champions, decision-makers and senior stakeholders across customer organizations • Working closely with SDRs, consultants and solution colleagues to shape strong and realistic solution directions • Guiding customers through decision-making processes with clarity, confidence and commercial ownership • Keeping pipeline, CRM data and sales information well structured and up to date • Creating repeatable and consistent ways of working that support predictable commercial results • Contributing to the further development of messaging, sales approaches and commercial best practicesYour profile What makes a strong fit • Several years of experience in sales, business development, account management or a similar commercial role • Ideally experience in SaaS, consulting, digital collaboration or solution-based selling • Strong communication and relationship-building skills • Confidence in speaking with different stakeholders, including senior decision-makers • A structured and disciplined way of working, with strong ownership and follow-through • The ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into commercially relevant opportunities • A proactive mindset and the ability to work independently in a dynamic environment • A high level of customer focus, credibility and professional presence • Fluent English, both spoken and written • Based in the United Kingdom, ideally within one hour of London • Interest in work management, process improvement and modern collaboration tools such as Asana is a strong advantage What makes this This gives us the flexibility to bring together the right talent across markets while staying connected through shared standards, close collaboration and a strong team culture.There is a shared culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement. jobs.occupation: Lead Engineer - Applied AI & Data Products (Leiter/in - Engineering)

environments, taking full technical ownership.• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and develop engineers within your team, shape our applied AI engineering practices, and ensure project and team success.• Thought Leadership: Represent SQUER's applied AI expertise externally — through client relationships, internal knowledge-sharing, or community engagement.Your qualifications• Extensive jobs.occupation: Teleoperator (m/w/d) – Robotersteuerung per VR [BA/JC] (Maschinen- und Anlagenführer/in (ohne Angabe des Schwerpunkts))
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Robotics Experte; Fernsteuerer/in (Robotik); Roboterbediener/in; KI-Trainer/inStellenbeschreibung:DeutschBerufsbezeichnung: Teleoperator / Teleoperatorin (m/w/d) – Robotersteuerung per VR (Praktikum mit Option auf Festanstellung)Über unsWir entwickeln die Technologie, mit der Roboter in der echten Welt sehen, verstehen und handeln können – in Lagern und Fabriken, nicht im Labor. Unsere Mission: die Lücken schließen, an denen klassische Automatisierung scheitert.Deine AufgabeDu steuerst Roboter über ein VR-Headset und hilfst so dabei, ihnen beizubringen, wie man Aufgaben in der echten Welt erledigt. Konkret:- Roboter per VR-Headset fernsteuern und dabei hochwertige Bewegungsdaten erzeugen- Bild- und Sensordaten sichten und mit hoher Sorgfalt kennzeichnen (Labeling)- Einfache, vorgegebene Abläufe am PC ausführen (wir zeigen dir genau, wie)- Auffälligkeiten dokumentieren: was ist passiert, was hättest du erwartet, wann genau- Enger Austausch mit einem kleinen, eingespielten TeamWas du mitbringen solltest- Keine Vorerfahrung nötig – wir bringen dir alles bei, was du für den Job brauchst- Gute Deutsch- oder gute Englischkenntnisse (mündlich und schriftlich)- Ruhige Hand, gutes Auge fürs Detail und Geduld bei sich wiederholenden Aufgaben- Grundlegende PC-Kenntnisse (E-Mails schreiben, Dateien verwalten reicht völlig)- Lust, dich in eine neue, ungewöhnliche Tätigkeit einzuarbeiten- Räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und gutes Reaktionsvermögen sind hilfreich – wer gern zockt, bringt hier oft schon ein gutes Gespür für Steuerung und Timing mit- Zuverlässigkeit und pünktliches ErscheinenWo und wieStuttgart-Vaihingen, vor Ort (kein Homeoffice möglich, da mit der Technik vor Ort gearbeitet wird).Art der Stelle & VerdienstStart als Praktikum, max. 6 Monate, Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche), 2.500 € brutto/Monat. Nach erfolgreichem Praktikum ist ein Einstieg in eine Festanstellung möglich, mit Verdienstmöglichkeiten von bis zu 65.000 € brutto/Jahr, abhängig von Erfahrung und Übernahme von Verantwortung.BewerbungBitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht nötig – schreib uns stattdessen kurz, warum du Lust auf die Stelle hast.Unser Ablauf1. Bewerbung (Lebenslauf + kurze Nachricht)2. Schnuppertag vor Ort: Du lernst das Team kennen und bearbeitest gemeinsam eine reale Aufgabe aus dem Arbeitsalltag, um ein echtes Gefühl für die Stelle zu bekommenEnglishJob title: Teleoperator (m/f/d) – Robot Control via VR (Internship with option to convert to full-time)Who We AreWe build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world – moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve.Your RoleYou'll control robots through a VR headset, helping teach them how to carry out real-world tasks. Specifically:- Operate robots via a VR headset to generate high-quality movement data- Review and label visual and sensor data with care and precision- Carry out simple, well-defined tasks on the computer (we'll show you exactly how)- Document anything unusual: what happened, what you expected, and when- Work closely with a small, hands-on teamWhat You Should Bring- No prior experience required – we'll teach you everything you need for the job- Good German or good English skills (spoken and written)- A steady hand, good attention to detail, and patience with repetitive tasks- Basic computer skills (writing emails, managing files is plenty)- Willingness to learn a new and unusual kind of work- Good spatial awareness and reaction time are a plus – if you enjoy video games, you likely already have a feel for control and timing- Reliability and punctualityLocation & SetupStuttgart-Vaihingen, on-site (remote work isn't possible, as the role requires working with the hardware in person).Type of Role & PayStarts as an internship, max. 6 months, full-time (40 h/week), €2,500 gross/month. After a successful internship, there's an opportunity to move into a full-time position, with earning potential of up to €65,000 gross/year, depending on experience and responsibility taken on.How to ApplyPlease send us your CV. A formal cover letter isn't necessary – just tell us briefly why you're interested in the role.Our Interview Plan1. Application (CV + short message)2. On-site assessment day: meet the team and work through a real challenge similar to the day-to-day role, to get a genuine feel for the environmentErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Qualitätskontrolle (einfache Kontrolltätigkeit)

jobs.occupation: Head of Inbound & Outbound Logistics (all genders) (Fachwirt/in - Logistiksysteme/Bachelor Professional in Logistiksysteme)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Ihre AufgabeSie übernehmen die Gesamtverantwortung für eine der operativ bedeutendsten Funktionen an unserem Standort Schnelldorf — die Leitung der gesamten Inbound- und Outbound-Logistik. In dieser Funktion gestalten Sie aktiv, wie Waren effizient, regelkonform und zuverlässig entlang einer komplexen internationalen Lieferkette bewegt werden. Sie führen ein Team von rund 45 Mitarbeitenden und tragen die Gesamtverantwortung für die Leistung der Logistikfunktion. Sie treiben die kontinuierliche Optimierung der Logistikprozesse voran — von Wareneingängen und Auslieferungen über die Gefahrgutabwicklung bis hin zur Zollabfertigung — und stellen dabei die vollständige Einhaltung aller relevanten Vorschriften sicher, einschließlich der Gefahrgutgesetzgebung und der Anforderungen an die Luftfrachtsicherheit. Sie fördern Digitalisierungsinitiativen, die die Arbeitsweise der Funktion modernisieren und nutzen SAP-basierte Systeme in den Bereichen Supply Chain Management, Order-to-Cash und Transport, um messbare Verbesserungen in Geschwindigkeit, Qualität und Kosteneffizienz zu erzielen. Als zentrale Schnittstelle innerhalb des Standorts und darüber hinaus arbeiten Sie eng mit Supply Chain Management, Lagerlogistik, Customer Service, Ländergesellschaften, Speditionen, Trade Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Quality und Zoll zusammen. Ihre Fähigkeit, über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg zu führen und strategische Prioritäten in operative Exzellenz zu übersetzen, ist entscheidend für Ihren Erfolg in dieser Rolle.Wer Sie sind- Sie verfügen über mindestens 10 Jahre Führungserfahrung in vergleichbarem Umfang und können eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Leitung großer, funktionsübergreifender Logistikteams in einem internationalen Umfeld vorweisen- Sie haben einen Masterabschluss, bevorzugt in Logistik, Supply Chain Management oder Betriebswirtschaft, oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation, die durch umfangreiche Berufserfahrung gestützt wird- Sie bringen umfassende Expertise in der Inbound- und Outbound-Logistik, der Gefahrgutabwicklung sowie im Zollwesen mit, einschließlich tiefgehender Kenntnisse der relevanten Rechtsgrundlagen und der Anforderungen an die Luftfrachtsicherheit- Sie verfügen über fundierte SAP-Kenntnisse in den Modulen Supply Chain Management, Order-to-Cash und Transport sowie über ausgeprägte Erfahrung mit den zugehörigen Logistik-IT-Systemen und eine klare Affinität zur Digitalisierung- Sie haben ein solides Verständnis betriebswirtschaftlicher Zusammenhänge, organisatorischer Prozesse und arbeitsrechtlicher Grundlagen, das es Ihnen ermöglicht, Ihr Team sowohl operativ als auch in der Personalführung sicher zu leiten- Sie kommunizieren fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch auf Verhandlungsniveau und verfügen über nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Präsentation und Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Dienstleistern und Stakeholdern aus unterschiedlichen Kulturkreisen- Sie bringen eine kontinuierliche Lernbereitschaft mit, unterstützt durch Weiterbildungen in Personalführung und Kommunikation, und sind motiviert, die Menschen in Ihrem Umfeld weiterzuentwickelnWhat we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space.Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly.Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleAs our CFO, you are responsible for all finance processes and decisions, and for growing the finance function across the Homaris Group from our Berlin office. You will have a great deal of freedom to build processes and structures, and you will play a decisive role in the company's growth by securing external financing and therefore our liquidity.This is a role with full ownership. You will shape how we budget, forecast, and steer the business, and you will prepare the finance function for the next stage of our expansion.If you've done this before in a demanding environment and you're looking for a place where the stakes are real and the room to grow is genuine, this could be the opportunity you have been looking for.What You'll Do Lead and structure the team. You lead the entire finance team and build it further in preparation for future expansion.Own budgeting, forecasting and liquidity. You take full ownership of budgeting and forecasting, and you develop short- and medium-term financial planning to secure the company's liquidity. You also manage payment flows.Assess investments. You prepare profitability analyses for planned and realised investments.Build company-wide controlling. This includes overseeing financial accounting, preparing and presenting actuals, analysing budget versus actuals, forecasting, and monitoring the liquidity position.Secure financing. You evaluate equity and debt financing, lead fundraising, hold discussions with banks and investors, and manage investor relationships.Digitalise finance. You drive the digitalisation of finance processes and establish the processes that go with it, automating and enabling AI where it makes sense to do so.What Makes You a Fit Qualifications and skillset. You have a (university of applied sciences) degree in business administration with a focus on finance or controlling, or a commercial apprenticeship with further training as a certified bookkeeper or controller, or an equivalent qualification. You also possess strong knowledge of finance and tax law, particularly under German GAAP (HGB), and are well versed in DATEV.Leadership and growth. You have at least five years of experience in finance and accounting, including leadership responsibility, ideally in a company with organic growth. You plan, organise, and implement with strength, and you think and act like an entrepreneur.Ownership and commitment. You bring a structured, independent, and responsible way of working, and a high level of commitment. You take ownership of outcomes and are confident and reliable.Tech affinity. You have a keen interest in digitalisation and continuously strive to implement AI and digital solutions, to save the team time and help them work in the most efficient way possible.Languages: German at native level (C2) and English at least at C1.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others.The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters.We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins.
